name: print-social-red-circle-and-arch-poster-look-through-the-hole
title: Red poster where black words pass through a circular hole cut into a red block
whatItIs: A white poster with a red circle behind giant black 'LOOK THROUGH' and a red rectangle below with a circular hole revealing white and the words 'THE HOLE IN THE WALL' cropped by the circle. Small text is centred and 'Look beyond the possible' repeats in the top corners.
whatItMeans: Clever and bold; the layout physically shows a hole in a wall.
techniques: Cut a circular window in a solid block.
Crop the text at the window edge.
Overlap type on a red circle.
Repeat a slogan in the top corners.

vocabulary.definition: A shape cut into a block revealing what is behind.
Text cut by a shape edge.
The same line at multiple corners.
